integrity_statement: Algebraic identities were reproduced symbolically. Analytic existence and orbital stability use the nondegenerate planar Hopf theorem; no independent review has been performed. A full comparison with the 2022 postprint was blocked by document access, leaving residual historical priority risk.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is local in the Hopf unfolding and pointwise for \(0<K<1\). No global cycle counts or finite-amplitude monotonicity follow. The 1968 historical Selkov paper uses a different printed vector field; the polynomial form is explicit in Strogatz (1994). The catalog date 1968-03-01 is a bibliographic date-only representation of a March 1968 publication, not a proven first-release day.
title: Two sign reversals in the near-Hopf period of a constant-determinant Selkov oscillator
